description: This PHP class 'Migration' is part of a database migration system for the OrangeHRM software, specifically handling updates for version 5.7.0. It performs database schema changes, data cleaning, and localization string updates as part of the software upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class manages database schema updates, data clean-up, and localization string management for OrangeHRM version 5.7.0 during migration.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs database updates: deleting translation strings, updating data groups, inserting permissions, creating new tables and foreign keys, and cleaning up old tables and data.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration ('5.7.0').

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper used for managing language strings.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version number of language strings in the database.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translation entries for a specific language string unit and group.

methods.name: dropOldTables
methods.description: Drops legacy tables no longer needed after migration.

methods.name: insertI18NError
methods.description: Inserts predefined internationalization error messages into the database.

methods.name: deleteUnusedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes a list of obsolete language strings based on predefined groups and keys.
